Kaali, a struggling Pondicherry orphan encounters his rich Goa doppelganger Malpe Upendra with criminal past, leading to identity swaps and messy consequences. Corrupt cop Thiraviyam and Upendra’s enemies soon conspire to put that to an end.

A petty thief embarks on a road trip with an elderly man suffering from memory loss under deceptive pretenses. As they journey across Tamil Nadu, the promise of an easy con unravels into a quietly shifting connection, with both men hiding secrets of their own.
After witnessing the cruel sacrifice of his childhood friend, an atheist warrior rejects religion until love forces him to find his own faith.

Supriya Pathak Kapur helms a titular role in a comic tale of 65-year-old Jasuben, who teams up with fellow homemakers to claim their financial independence, proving, as she says, "Why should boys have all the funds?"
Shiva, a rational ghost hunter, man of science and reason—is drawn back to the mystery of a powerful guardian spirit named Dhanapisachi, pulled into a world where his beliefs are tested.
A savior, Odela Mallanna Swamy, protects a village from evil forces.

Carefree photographer Arjun lives and works with his uncle Sam, who owns a wedding photography agency. At a destination wedding, he meets pottery instructor Pooja and the two agree for a short-lived fling. For the first time, Arjun feels genuine emotion, but Pooja ends it as planned.

Mahasenha is a mythological jungle thriller set in the mystichills of Kurangani, where an ancient Yaali sculpture, worshipped by the tribal villagers as a divine protector, becomes the center of a high-stakes conflict. The film delivers a powerful message : Faith is not just belief-its protection.

On the edge of a misty hilltop in rural Kerala, a young man named Arjun prepares to end his life. It’s the day of his beloved Anu’s wedding—an unbearable moment for a heart that had loved silently and shattered quietly.

When easygoing Karthik falls head over heels for his charming neighbour, he thinks love is simple. But the closer he gets, the more tangled his world becomes, full of hidden truths, shocking lies, and unexpected twists

The film is female oriented. Anshu is the hero of the film and a small screen star while Anshu is a big businessman. Belle wants to make her own biopic but does not have finance, while Anshu transfers 10 Crores to her account.
Sundaramoorthy, a timid lawyer, takes on the case of a man who sets himself on fire outside the court to protest his daughter's abduction. Can Sundaramoorthy confront his fears and reveal the truth?
Three friends bond and their coming of age graph against a backdrop of kite-flying as a sports event.
A Gujarati immigrant in Los Angeles balances jobs, schemes, and romance while pursuing his green card, until love and hidden truths clash in a tale of dreams, family, and fresh starts.

Shyam, an engineering graduate from Hyderabad, reluctantly takes up the job of Panchayat Secretary in Sivarapalli, a remote village in Telangana, due to a lack of job options. The show follows Shyam as he navigates the idiosyncrasies and absurdities of village life and his job while preparing for the GMAT, hoping to leave the village and move to the USA.

Vijay, a bank employee, falls in love with Purva at first sight and attempts to get closer to her in hopes of winning her affection. Meanwhile, Harini who secretly harbours feelings for Vijay, begins to follow him—turning his love life into a comedic triangle.
Sanal departs Cochin Airport in the rain, journeying through Idukki's landscapes to meet Leena and fulfil their dream, while their hearts weave through shared memories of joy and sorrow.

Set in the 1980s in the remote and fear-stricken, eerie village of Viraatapalem, which faces a strange chilling curse – every bride dies mysteriously on her wedding day, halting marriages for over a decade. A determined police constable refuses to believe this superstition and, along with a reformed convict, begins to unearth shocking secrets the villagers want hidden.

Bomb is a comedy film set in the fictional village of Kaalakammaipatty, where a man named Kathiravan dies unexpectedly but even after death, he won’t stop farting. His body becomes the center of chaos, confusion, and laughter as the villagers try to figure out the Reason.

Sofia, a brilliant but emotionally guarded scientist, believes love is nothing more than biology. After witnessing her parents' relationship fall apart, she invents a device called the Love Meter to prove that true love can be measured.
In the battle between love and lust, a tribal man fights to save his deaf and mute girlfriend from a ruthless forest officer, unravelling cat and mouse drama within the heart of the forest.

Kannan,  with a past comes to Malaysia to turn over a new leaf. But when he realises that the girl he loves needs money to get out of a difficult situation, he commits a robbery that makes him the target of a fearsome gangster and the girl’s stepfather, an immoral cop.
A taxi driver finds himself embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy after his car is confiscated by a corrupt police officer.

Gatha Vaibhava is a fantasy drama that weaves together history, mythology, and destiny. When Purathan and Adhunika meet in the present, they embark on a mystical journey through their past lives from the divine realms of Devaloka to Vasco da Gama's voyage and the coastal lands of pre-independence Karnataka. As echoes of the past resurface, they must unravel their fate. Will love endure across lifetimes, or is history doomed to repeat itself?

Set in rural Gujarat, Sarpanch is a gripping drama about a village chief caught between tradition and progress. As politics and personal values clash, he must lead with heart—while facing love, duty, and tough decisions. A powerful tale of leadership and change.

ADGP Dhruv, a seasoned high-ranking police officer haunted by a tragic past, grapples with a labyrinthine case, where every clue unearths a darker secret. As he uncovers clues linking to a mysterious swimmer, he races against time to stop a cunning serial killer driven by dark secrets.
A journey of facing life’s twists & tests with laughter and love!

Timma, a Western Ghat local, seeks funds for his son's education and a new home. Disrupting his belief in spirituality, he goes on to find king cobra's eggs (considered divine) for money on behest of outsiders (Snake Research team).

A well-known movie critic is invited by a strange person to watch a special horror film. But once the movie starts, he finds himself trapped inside it. The world keeps shifting timelines, endless day-to-night cycles, non-linear narration, and scary things from horror movies come to life. To escape, he must either stop reviewing movies forever or find a way to defeat the ghost that trapped him.

On his way to a long-overdue drinking party with two friends, Anish receives an unexpected call from Anjana, a past lover visiting the city. Their decision to meet sets the stage for an evening of easy banter, reopened wounds, and difficult choices.
When a renowned tech entrepreneur is kidnapped upon returning to India, a police officer recruits her ex-boyfriend, a former cop now living a quiet family life, to assist in the rescue mission.

A family drama that explores the emotional layers of a household where love is rarely spoken but deeply felt. Through conflict, silence, and resilience, it reveals what it takes to keep a family from falling apart.
A conniving maths teacher enlists a group of indebted villagers to participate in a bank robbery.
Twelve years after saving his daughter Arya from a dark force, Atharva learns it never left her. When strange events begin again, he must fight to save her once more.

In the fictional town of sanna koppa ,the story begins with santhosh's murder.as the investigation unfolds ,Rippan swamy dives into a gripping psychological rural thriller set amidst estate workers ,town homes and hidden conflicts.

'Mithya' is a journey alongside Mithun, an eleven-year-old, coming to terms with the sudden loss of his parents. Things turn gloomier as their families squabble over his custody, even as questions over the nature of his Father's death remain unanswered. We walk in step with Mithun/Mithya's tottering feet, as they search for solid ground. Can a new house be home, can friendships be forged again or is it all just a search for something long gone?
Two dimwit cops must survive the most terrifying night of their lives to win the things that matter most.

In a peaceful village full of joy, laughter, and vibrant life, everything seems perfect—until one day, the devil arrives. What follows is a hilarious chain of events that flips the entire village upside down!
A rickshaw driver trapped in a farmhouse confronts his past demons while experiencing visions of Lord Krishna, who guides him through a transformative journey of self-discovery and healing.

In the famine-stricken village of Kothalavadi, greed sparks chaos as a ruthless scrap dealer manipulates desperate villagers into illegal sand mining, using them as pawns in his quest for power. When tragedy strikes and blood is spilt, an iron-willed officer, a betrayed enforcer, and a cunning politician clash for control. As tensions rise, the villagers must choose: break free or be consumed by their greed.
A son must defend his father in court after a bribery accusation, forcing them to confront their strained relationship while fighting for justice in this legal drama.

Jalebi Rocks is a heartfelt and inspiring film about Vidya Pathak, a 48-year-old housewife. It's a family film that creates a satisfying and unforgettable experience for every family member. Jalebi Rocks celebrates resilience, self-worth, and the indomitable spirit of a woman who refuses to be defined by her age or circumstances. It is a story of achievement, proving that it is never too late to pursue one's dreams and create a fulfilling, meaningful life.
Abandoned as a child, Aleena grows up longing for love. Will life ever lead her back to her lost parents and the happiness she dreams of?

Bachu Bapodara, a miser and health freak, is on a free trip to Bangkok. A mystery woman, wild adventures, and heartfelt twists make his journey hilarious and emotional. 'Bachu Ni Benpani' is a perfect film for the whole family.
A pair of ordinary slippers becomes the center of chaos when a diamond smuggler uses them as a hiding spot, triggering a frantic search across town.

Devoted mother Aashka sacrifices her career to raise Meera and Kabir while husband Kunal gets consumed by work. Feeling neglected, she leaves but mentors students needing maternal care. Her absence makes the family realize her worth.
A film crew unknowingly welcomes a true psychopath onto their set. But when they push his buttons one too many times, their shoot turns into a deadly game of survival.

Seven women from rural Gujarat embark on their first international trip to London, facing cultural clashes, language barriers, and societal stigmas along their journey to claim their space in the world.

The craziest Gujjubhai adventure where chaos happens as a mysterious girl proposes Gujjubhai in front of his wife, and his mother-in-law is supposed to arrive with ₹10 crore as per his father-in-law’s wish. Can Gujjubhai tackle all this through his bluff and insane hilarity?
A 1990s tale inspired by the lost treasure of Karnataka's Kadamba dynasty. Their first king Mayura Sharma's legacy intertwines with Maari, a deity said to guard the hidden riches.
On the day of Gandhi Jayanti, when meat sale is prohibited nationwide, an 11-year-old girl goes on a quirky adventure in pursuit of a forbidden chicken curry.

In Bijapur,an orphaned auto driver falls in love and follows a girl into college,where playful revenge against bullies takes many twists—yet can the wisdom of the city’s monuments turn conflict into love,respect,and harmony?
Distraught Aditya finds himself on a road trip with three strangers who offer different perspectives on his life.

Set in the rustic heart of northern Gujarat, Kundaalu (Circle) captures the harsh beauty of rural life where tradition reigns supreme and marriage defines destiny. Amid this unyielding world, Mangu, a destitute orphan, and Vikas, a spirited man burdened by a speech impediment, find a fragile connection, only to be separated by fate's cruelty. Their intertwined lives reflect a haunting portrait of love, loss, and resilience within a society that hears neither their voices nor their pain.
In a fearful town, whispers of Malik, a mysterious and intimidating figure, spread like wildfire. As the community grapples with fear, individuals speculate about Malik's true identity.

A poor family from North Karnataka moves to Bangalore in search of a better life. Their journey takes an unexpected turn when they find a lost puppy belonging to a wealthy family. As the bond between the boy and the puppy deepens, a heartwarming tale unfolds, blending humor and emotion to celebrate the pure connection between two innocent souls

Following a bitter heartbreak, orphaned Victor crashes his lover's wedding, unknowingly sparking a violent feud with the salt mafia that rules the infamous land of Maliya Miyana. What begins as a quest for revenge quickly spirals into a deadly game of betrayal and bloodshed. As the conflict unfolds, Victor learns his true identity, and the legacy he never knew he had, forcing him to confront his past and claim the future he was always meant to inherit.

A dementia patient finds herself at the center of a murder investigation, desperately trying to piece together scattered memories that may identify the killer - if she can trust what her mind tells her.
Family relationships get hilariously complicated when three connected brothers-in-law find themselves in increasingly absurd situations.
Lohit Rajesh, a man who works on an IT firm and infamously known to be a lefty gets caught up in a murder after he meets with a mysterious woman.

An accidental love story between Stavan and Mugdha. They fall in love with one another in Goa and later decide never to meet each other again. What happened between the two? Will they ever meet again?
Parshi and Anitha, two spirited youngsters from rural Telangana, are madly in love and decide to elope. Meanwhile, a shocking twist emerges.
Novice Meghna and her two accomplices plot to honey trap Sanjay for revenge, facing humorous and moral challenges. Will she let revenge consume her?
A working mom and her witty housekeeper navigate their complex relationship while managing home and career. Their love-hate dynamic unfolds in this relatable comedy.

Sammelanam is a gripping Telugu web series that unravels love, friendship &long-buried secrets. When a bestselling novel exposes the past of four estranged friends,they are forced to confront old betrayals,lost love that never truly faded.

Akhil's world turns upside down when his wife Khushi is hospitalised for a high-risk delivery that demands urgent medical attention and a large sum of money. Struggling to arrange even a few thousand rupees, Akhil finds himself in a desperate situation. The film explores his emotional and financial turmoil and the events that led him to this breaking point.

Aastha return to her roots for a wedding, only to face love, judgment, and a shadow from her past. Amidst family, tradition, and turmoil, she find strength in bonds and faith in Dwarkadishji. Tale of heart, truth, finding one's voice-this is Jalso.

In Kolkata's shadows and Varanasi's light, a mother's love and a Truck driver's guilt collide. Kaashi Raaghav is a story of vengeance, redemption, and sacrifice - where fate burns brighter than hope. A lost child, a haunted past, and a tragic love story: Kaashi-Raaghav unravels a journey through betrayal, redemption, and the flames of an unforgiving society.

An 80-year-old woman faces four wild options after a government program disrupts her life: revenge on family, rekindling romance, living luxuriously, or choosing it all in this comedy about family surprises
Chaatar is a raw, heartfelt coming-of-age story of rebellion, resilience, and the struggle to reclaim a future set in the unforgiving terrain of a forgotten land.

The tale of Navneet Rai Sanghavi and family: a pillar of tradition, unity, and love. When fate tests them with unexpected trials, their bond, resilience, and spirit shine, proving that true family endures every storm. 'Sanghavi and Sons' celebrates togetherness.

Goti Lo follows Dadaji's clever plan to reunite his gadget-addicted family in their village. To save their ancestral home, they must win a traditional games challenge - rediscovering real-life bonds, roots, and the joy beyond screens.
Two stylish thieves head to Goa with stolen riches. Picking up a stranger who recognizes one of them turns their escape into a dangerous web of lies - revealing dark secrets beyond their heist.
Priya, a modern girl is brought up in an orthodox household. As she strives to break free from her traditional family, she falls in love.
